review_description: I received quotes from four companies, one of which was a company that friends had dealt with (I did not choose that company). I met with two suppliers, and went with Soltek as their representative was very knowledgeable and in particular, didn't try to 'upsell', even when I relayed suggestions from friends as to certain aspects of the system. He explained everything really well, with scenario examples. My knowledge in this field is minimal, to say the least, so I was grateful for his advice. The installation was done today and the installers were excellent. They arrived on time, were polite, friendly, and left absolutely no mess. They explained how the system works, showed me the app which monitors the system, and how that works, and answered all my questions. I highly recommend Soltek.However, I have raised with them the fact that their communication was a little lax between paying the deposit and the installation date. There was apparently a shortage of components which they were awaiting from China, which is reasonable, but I did raise my concerns with them that they should have kept me updated via email or a phone call, rather than me having to be the one to chase them. I think this is an administrative failing which should be addressed.Aside from this, I would still recommend Soltek.
Great customer service. Kept meep to speed with install progress. Helpful with supplier information.

It has been six months since the installation of the 13.2 KW SolarEdge and battery system. In short, everything has been running great. I work from home and have two Uni students here, “far too much”.  On one sunny day, I used the ducted air-con, oven, cook top, dishwasher, and washing machine and paid nothing.My feedback on the installers: I appreciated the pre-installation site visit. They were on time, professional, solutions-oriented and meticulous.  They left the place tidy and removed all materials.  Their communication was always clear, always taking the time to answer my questions, no matter how small. But most importantly, they were just great guys.As always, there were minor issues here and there. However, they took the initiative to engage with Head Office proactively and followed up so that all issues were promptly resolved.Communication and customer service pre and post installation with Head Office has been excellent.Regarding the sales process. The agent was always available for calls and questions throughout the quote process and determination of the correct system, coming in person to my house twice. Communication was clear, and he provided everything I needed to understand to make an informed decision. In short, it was straight talk, not "sales talk”So, touch wood, long may things continue.
Good explanation of the options. Smooth installation and overall professional service.

Great company for the near-total amateur. They returned my calls promptly, answered my questions in language I could understand, then gave me time to research other outcomes and/or potential problems for myself. I appreciated them not doing the 'hard sell' and appreciated their no-fuss resolution to a problem that occurred in the initial installation of the solar panels. I followed up with battery installation and was just as impressed. The installers were very helpful- clear and patient in their explanations and made great suggestions how I could maximise the benefits of my new solar system. I have no doubt that if, in the future, I run into problems or forget some aspects managing the system, that they will provide  me with helpful advice and/or a speedy resolution. Thankyou Soltek

I had Damien attend to my house was very polite, he had walked me through all the options I could have of a solar and battery combination at my house with a hot water unit. I had settled on a red X system with a 20kw battery and a reclaim hot water tank.The install process was quick and the staff I had engaged with were friendly well informed and educated on the products.The office informed me very well of the Government rebates I was entitled too and always kept me posted on my install date.I had my install done by Blake he was a massive help very approachable throughout the day, keeping me posted on all activates that had to take place at my home, He alike the staff at Soltek and the technician walked me through the Red X system monitoring app as well.I have just received my bill with a family of 6 in winter and have been credited 20 bucks this a lot better compared to my average 600 dollar bill I was receiving preinstall.I Recommend the RED X system, Jinko panels and a hot water unit from Damien and his team.

Good luck with trying to get service from Soltek during warranty. Support and service during warranty is almost non existent.I have a problem since 07-Apr-2025, first reported to Soltek on 23-April, 2025. Have been following up almost on a weekly basis with Soltek Support person.No action yet, just excuses.May need to get Dept. of Fair Trading Involved

Panels were installed within a week of accepting their quote. Battery took 3 months before it was installed, though I was told it would be 6 weeks.An additional panel was installed afterwards, as they didn't maximise roof capacity initially (which was the brief), but his panel still isn't producing energy according to the app, despite weeks of trying to get it sorted.Emails are not replied to. When calling or messaging i typically get the response that their engineer is looking at it, but without anything actually being resolved.After installation our roof started leaking. We had a roofer come to inspect and he advised us a roof tile was broken due to the installation. Now we'll need them to take away one panel and fix this..It's great to have solar + battery, but it shouldn't be such a painful process.
Good service and advise from the supplier, we had many questions and nothing was a problem.

We highly recommend Soltek Energy.Our experience with Soltek throughout the process to get our solar system installed was great.Mike from Soltek came to our house to assess our solar requirements, provided helpful advice and discussed with us various options. He took the time to listen to what we wanted and recommended a system that met our needs. We had confidence in his advice and recommendation.The installation team, led by Carlo, were professional, friendly, punctual and polite. Carlo clearly explained how the installation would be undertaken and was able to locate cable ducting so it was unobtrusive. A very neat and tidy job. Carlo also explained how to use the MySolarEdge app to monitor our system.Soltek efficiently managed the process to get our smart meter installed.We are completely satisfied with our solar system from Soltek.

Salesperson provided options for all the required panels, inverters and batteries.Left final decision up to me.Visited the site and ran through the options and provided detail quotes and fact sheets.Installation team were fantastic.App is easy to use.
Good upfront pre-install service. Dealing with warranty issues is not their strength.

After the sale, customer service is non-existent. Our panels and Tesla Battery were installed in 2019, but then the Tesla app stopped working. Tesla tells me it is the installer problem, and Soltek tells me it is Tesla's problem. I tried to fix the thing myself first following their instructions; furthermore, I had an IT person trying to connect the app to the battery, but he could not do it either. I have tried to get someone to come to do a service call from Soltek, but they no longer answer my email. Zero stars.
Excellent service provided by the sales representative and installers. Slight issue with the final invoice, however this was quickly rectified by customer service staff and new invoice re-issued.

Was provided was 3 separate options for systems including 3 types of panels and batteries. Was not told just to buy the most expensive one, and they listened to my requirements carefully.Installation was extremely efficient with panels and conduits installed by 11am, battery and wiring all completed by 1pm and full commissioning completed by 3pm.Power was being produced that day, battery fully topped up and I have barely used any power from the grid in the 21 days since installation.Electrician also gave advice on covering the inverter and battery to protect from the direct sunlight.
Clear quotationOn timeFriendly sales, follow up and iinstallation crew
Start to finish the process was easy and a pleasure!

Sales process was quite simple, no lengthy proposal which had us bamboozled, in fact the Sales person wrote down basic details on the inside of the sales folder which I was ok with.Installation went well, installer and myself had common interest in that we both support West Tigers in NRL, plus he was good in explaining how the app works. His team were punctual and they finished the job ahead of schedule being a Saturday.Now the customer service post installation I found very poor. No person informed me about installing a smart meter with our Energy provider, I sent 2 emails to the company (after googling) on this matter and received no reply, I also lost the layout plan on the app which was there on installation day, once again no reply from Soltek. There was no checklist issued to me, The sales rep told me he wasn't sure if the relevant person had lodged the documents as he only works part-time. As system was installed on 8 Nov it was nearly a month later that I received a copy of the documents they had just sent to Origin with a request to expediate the matter, Turns out I had to also complete a form last night and after being issued an ID number Origin this afternoon confirmed they'll be here on 2 Jan 2025 to install smart meter. Hence it will be nearly 2 months after the system was installed.Heaven forbid if I need to contact them down the track for any form of service. I just got the impression that once they got our money we were left to work things out for ourself whilst they purely focus on new business.

Everything went as expected. The quote was reasonable and they took the time to talk through benefits of different options. Panels were installed landscape, which meant could get maximum capacity out of the roof space. Other quotes were all portrait so less panels.The installers were genuinely nice people.

The job was a replacement of an old array of solar panels and inverter (17+ years old) with new panels and a battery.  Also included was the integration of an existing array of LG panels that are approximately six years old.The Soltek team did a fantastic job from start to finish. They arrived early and left late and most importantly left the site clean and spotless. The install for both the solar panels and battery went to plan with a minimum of fuss and bother and was a very professional neat and tidy job. Very happy with the outcome.
Quoting was good, installation was perfect, and customer service was good.
Quick, easy, well priced and concisely explained.Installation was exactly as described.Would go with Soltek again any day.

Positive experience with quotation, explaining pros/cons for each of the solar panels and inverters at each price point, optimal panel layout and considerations if additional bf more panels or battery later. Quick turnaround, installers professional, polite and clean. Arranged grid connection and smart meter install as part of service.
Good, knowledgeable sales person, and good installer and installation process. One issue after the smart meter was installed, but it was corrected immediately.

Sebastian and his installation team did a very thoughtful installation. Whilst there were some initial nerves about our roof tiles, they carefully installed the rails and only needed to replace one tile. Fantastic!System looks great on our roof.Only now waiting on details of how to use the Sungrow app and installed meter to monitor our usage and output to the grid. All in all a very professional experience in an industry that is known to have many shoddy operators.I recommend Soltek highly.

Sales / quoting. : Showed how we could save more electricity by installing Heat Pump hot waterInstallation started on time. Had a few days delay due to high winds. Job site cleaned when work completed.After sales service has been excellent.

I obtained 3 quotes. One installer did not want to quote and Solar Quotes provided a replacement installer. I ended up selecting Soltek Energy because of the choice of options and reviews. I chose Winaico panels with Enphase microinverters. Installation was completed within a week of accepting the quote. It was all completed in a day. A week later Soltek installed my heat pump, completed within a few hours. The whole process was seamless.

The Soltek sales person was on time and had a detailed inspection of premises. Sat down and discussed how the technology works and what options we could have in size and quality of componentsThe quote that arrived was very detailed with a range of size, quality of solar panels and inverters, this allowed us to choose what we thought was the right system for us. There were about 9 options provided with one recommended. We went with the recommended oneThe installation team were prompt and efficient. The electrician explained what he was doing and worked with us with actual inverter location and conduit options.I had one small problem with the app that didn't show consumption, Soltek rang me back and helped to fix the problem. It was actually a software problem in the app with the inverter company. This was fixed in a day and everything is working fine.I highly recommend the process and company

Salesperson came to site and went through the solar panel options and inspected the layout of the tiled roof and advices on power size options. We have an unusual 2 phase supply to the house.Installation was done in an afternoon on a tiled two storey roof breaking only a couple of tiles.Service was good after install and supplier arranged grid installation and inspections.Read the contract fine print. This installer had fair payment terms compared to others.

We had previously used this installer for our original solar system some 8 years ago. We thought we'd use them again to add on new solar panels, upgrade the inverter and install a battery. Unfortunately this time round, it was such a bad experience!Looking back on it all, the installation team didn't seem to be too experienced and the process all seemed a bit piece-meal. The electricians kept having to call back to the head office to get instructions on what to do and how to install things... this should have been a warning sign, but since our previous installation all went well, we didn't think too much of it at the time and trusted the company and their staff (mistake number 1). One of the installers even fell through an awning during the installation (which he shouldn't have been stepping on in the first place!) Thankfully he wasn't too injured!When the job wasn't completely done (as the installers needed to come back later in the week to complete some small tasks), Soltek was quite forceful in demanding the remainder of the payment be sent through despite not completing all the work. As they had provided good customer service previously and as the bulk of the installation was done, I trusted that they would follow up in a timely fashion and get all the work done, so I proceeded (foolishly) to pay the remainder of the balance. Boy was that a bad move! (mistake number 2)After having the battery installed, the house was consuming twice as much energy whenever the battery was being used. When we tried to contact Soltek about this, they completely disregarded our concerns, outright lied to us that the system was working correctly when it wasn't, and then went on to blame SolarEdge for the system malfunctioning... a brand new inverter and battery which was incorrectly installed by Soltek! They didn't have the manpower, technical knowledge or decency to properly troubleshoot the issue with us or SolarEdge. We had to contact SolarEdge ourselves to escalate the issue further. Eventually (1-2 months later) SolarEdge thankfully sent out their own technician to review the installation as the Soltek worker that was sent out "couldn't find any problems with the installation". Indeed the system was incorrectly installed (incorrectly wired) and it wasn't even initialised properly! The SolarEdge technician was able to promptly diagnose and fix the wiring and now, finally, the system is working as it was designed to.3-4 months on, we still have cracked roof tiles that have not been replaced (we have spare tiles ready), the system layout still has not been updated with SolarEdge, and radio silence from them about when they would complete the remaining work.We wished that we could give glowing reviews to Soltek, as our original experience with this company was very positive, however 8 years on, it seems that they no longer value their customers - poor customer service, poor after sales support, poor communication, outright lies after receiving payment for a botched install.
Quoting was smooth and the ensuing negotiations pleasing. Commitments were kept and timelines adhered to. Both the salesperson and the installer did an excellent job and we are now up and running.

Sales rep Damien was an engineer who had detailed knowledge of all panel, inverter and battery options.  Quote included three panel / inverter options and three battery options.  Discussed pros / cons of each option.  Installation in one day was seamless with strong lead-hand Patrick who took care of the details.  Very good after sales service including set-up of SolarEdge monitoring system on computer and phone.  All paperwork with retailer was handled by Soltek including installation of smart meter.
Grid connection was not organised as promised and no promise to connect battery.

Mike at Soltek was great to deal with. Competitive pricing and solid information provided in relation to any queries. Very timely and extremely professional installation - they did a great job in a "busy" area. A real pleasure to work with on this project. Would strongly recommend -  thanks Finn and team for the steer!

The sales quoting process was quick and succinct.All details of the various solar panels and inverters and batteries were clearly written and tabulated.It made choosing the right solar panels for my home easier.The technicians were punctual. They were polite and friendly. Did a good job. They were careful not to break any tiles and they cleaned up after their work.The technician showed me how to turn off the inverter and how to check the inverter status. He answered my various questions.They helped organize the grid connection after the installation.There was a small problem with the battery not talking to the inverter but Soltekenergy helped rectify it.

We used Soltek for our solar installation on an older house in the Eastern Suburbs of Sydney. The Sales and Quoting process went very smoothly. The Sales Person made phone contact on the first business day after doing the "three quotes" with SolarQuotes. He visited our home on the following day and we talked through possibilities for panels and inverters. Ours was a straightforward design, since we had only two, rectangular, 30o sloping, west-facing roof sections to place panels. (There is an Edwards Solar Hot Water system on the small north-facing roof section, that provides hot water for two of us for about $10-$20 per year, at current rates.) The matrix quote for panels and inverters made it easy to see and compare costs for 9 different systems. This initial quote really helps you decide how much you want to spend and where to make compromises. Our main focus was to install as much "power" on the available roof area as possible, since our earlier (2010) solar system was only 2.34kW (12 panels at 195W each) and we realised that in real world situations, much more power was needed to run various electric appliances e.g. RC air-conditioning uses about 2.0-2.4kW, the dishwasher about 2.4kW, a column heater from 1.2-2.4kW, the oven about 2.4kW etc.  We wanted a system that would fully power the operation of some of these appliances. We were able to get an 8.8kW system. We ended up going with "entry-level" panels that we are very happy with i.e. 20 Jinko Tiger N-type All Black 440W panels with a "top- end" SolarEdge SE8250 Home Hub Inverter with Power Optimisers for the panels. The installation occurred about 2 weeks after the site visit (but we may have got in on a cancellation). The installers were polite, helpful, careful and installed the panels where we wanted them i.e. high up on the roof sections.  They arrived a bit later than we expected (due to finishing a previous job), but finished our installation of 20 panels and inverter within the day.  The work was very neat, including the alignment of panels and the cabling.  It took a repeat visit a few days later to get the system up and running, apparently because of a mislabelling of something within the inverter during its manufacture. This was easily sorted out by a phone call. Then, a few days later, there was a bit of a problem (some sort of optimisation / configuration issue), but this was fixed remotely by SolarEdge. We were very happy with the follow-up service by Soltek, after installation. The system has been running now for 7 weeks during winter, without any further problems.  The system is performing as predicted in terms of power output. We are regularly getting (winter) 4-5 kW maximum output, well above the 2.4kW needed for appliances. We were already grid-connected and had a Smart Meter (with our previous solar system) and Soltek arranged the Connection Application with AUSGRID for our new system and forwarded the Contract Notification Letter to us.  Soltek provided us with the required paperwork for the CCEW (Certificate of Compliance - Electrical Work), as well the "Soltek Energy Workmanship & Installation Warranty Certificate", serial numbers of the 20 Jinko panels, a Tax Invoice & Receipt. The SolarEdge Home Hub gives access to the SolarEdge phone app, which allows real time monitoring of power production, power usage within the house and power export to the grid. This is really useful if you want to maximise self-consumption of your solar power, which is the key to its financial benefits. We had some shading issues on one of the roof sections (chimney in winter), but it appears that the optimisers are dealing with that quite well, based on the panel-level monitoring which you can also see with the app.  Incidentally, we were advised to have some spare roof tiles handy, in case of breakages, with heavy panel & heavy people during installation.  We bought 20 from RoofTileRecyclers (Prospect, Sydney) and about half of these were needed.

Sales person presented simply, hand sketched   summary  of system with no frills spreadsheets or software .  Sales person was an installer/electrical engineer and was able to inspect power board and check if  additional work required that others who quoted were not able to do.Installers were punctual and communicated delays due to weather.  Good quality installation and  followed up with grid connection.  Made changes on site to panel layout so system size maintained.

Every aspect from the initial quote through to the actual panel installation with Soltek has been efficient, professionally conducted and well communicated. The quoting process was clear, thoroughly informative, not just "sales talk". Only waited about a week before a very knowledgeable team arrived to do the installation. They were well organised, polite, kept us informed of each step they were doing and finished the job to a very high standard.Customer service and followup in arranging grid connection etc with our provider has been excellent.Overall, we could not fault the quality of the product we purchased nor the service we received from Soltek.

The sales consultant was punctual, polite and patient. He answered  my questions and informed me of all the options available to me, in terms of cost and quality, for both panels and inverters. And then followed up with a detailed written quotation.The installers were polite, hardworking, tidy and professional, staying til early evening to finish the install on the same day.With regard to the grid connection, I did need to chase that up, but once i called them, they were very prompt in putting in the request to my provider.Overall, I am very satisfied with my experience with Soltek

Quote was great in comparison, very professional the salesman and gave us information on all aspects of the installation process.Customer service great installation went smoothly very tidy no rubbish left.Efficient and organised our grid connection and the app for us to check how our solar was performing each day.

Quote process was very informative and Mike took lots of time to explain everything really clearly. Although I had another quote that was more expansive and detailed, the Soltek quote was a long way below and compelling, so we decided to go with them. Everything arrived and was installed as expected and on time. Love the app showing us our energy generation vs consumption - it's strangely addictive!

Damian was very knowledgable during the quoting  and answered all my questions clearly.The installation crew were polite and worked hard, they delivered a quality system neatly installed.Soltek organized the solar connection/ meter  very efficiently.  They also installed the system on the day requested.The system is producing better than promised so I am very happy overall.My only complaint was that the roofing crew broke a lot of tiles by trying to remove the tile nail by pulling on the tile.  They said the tile nails were longer than usual which is why so many tiles were being broken. When I found out what was happening I provided a pair of pincers to cut the nail or pull it out without breaking the tile.  Up to this point every tile with a nail was being broken.This was a new roof so I wasn’t happy that so many tiles were being broken and that the roofing crew didn’t consider this to be a problem.  They would have happily continued breaking every tile with a nail.  Apart from this I was happy with the quality of the installation.

The installation was a 6.6 kWh system for the use of the middle level unit of a three unit concrete residential  strata property.The panels with micro-inverters are on the roof of the four level structure and the switchboard and meters are located in a concrete walled room in the basement.It was found that all the existing wiring in the building between the air-conditioning units and telecoms equipment on the roof and the switchboard room in the basement had been laid during the construction of the building and there was no void through which to run the wiring from the micro-inverters to the meters. It was also determined that there was no other way to run the wiring from the roof to the basement, internally or external to the structure, that would be code compliant.Initially it was thought that this was death a sentence for the project, but after further examination of the existing electrical set-up on the roof, Soltek came up with the idea of connecting the micro-inverters to the circuit providing power to the air-conditioning unit through a sub-switchboard installed on the roof.  This proved to be feasible and the installation proceeded in that manner.The physical installation itself was conducted as scheduled without any inconvenience to the residents of the units.The system was operational immediately after completion of the physical installation, generating power for domestic use, monitorable on the multi-inverter software application.With the subsequent installation of the smart meter by the electricity retailer, it is now possible, using both the retailer's and the multi-inverter's software applications, to monitor power generation and the amount drawn from and fed into the grid on an hourly basis.
Smart, clued up, both best n cheapest of 3 quotes.Did it in a day and advised on application and paperwork,  Smart nice people..

Had a customer service rep come out to the house, look at the property and then sit with me and explain differences in systems etc.Booked about a week later and 2/3 weeks after that the installers came. They were so professional, genuinely nice people and they took their time to explain anything and ask questions etc.Really happy with the system, the app and how easy the whole process was.
Salesman came to visit and took the time to explain options. They were responsive with information requests and competitive with price. Installation was prompt, efficient and professional.

We were very happy with the sales person and the communication from the company. I had a million questions and the sales person was very helpful.Due to the busyness of the time of year - before Christmas - our appointment was put back twice, but all good.Installation was seamless and installers worked hard and did a great job. They arrived on time and were respectful. Three installers completed everything by 3pm in one day.Everything went as planned and communication was timely.I have recieved all documentation as promised and Red Energy has installed the new smart meter already for remote monitoring. The SolarEdge app works well to tell me what the system is producing and what we are consuming from solar and the grid.Very happy with our purchase and the panels look great on the roof - when you notice that they are there!

The information provided from Soltek during the quotation process was exactly what need. Easy to understand while still presenting technical information.The installer turned up on time and did a really good job.In 5 days since install it has produced more power than estimated.Very happy customer

All three companies that I obtained quotes from had excellent and very responsive salespeople.  Soltek's salesman was marginally better with his answers to technical questions and persuaded us to buy a Solar Edge string system with optimisers instead of an Enphase micro-inverter system.  (Another company had also recommended a string system with optimisers over a micro-inverter system.)  The presentation of Soltek's quote for several alternative systems, with equipment from various manufacturers, showed their technical features and prices in the way that made it easiest to compare them.  Finally, Soltek agreed to a discount to match another company's quote.Just before accepting the quote, I realised that a small group of PV panels on the western roof might be vulnerable to shadow from a chimney and a basketball backboard.  Soltek's salesman proposed a modified positioning of those panels, but no decision was made.Our installation was booked to start at 9 am on a Thursday, as I had told Soltek that that was the only day that I could be on site.  At 10 am I called Soltek to find out why nobody had turned up.  It emerged that, because on the Tuesday rain had been predicted for the Thursday, Soltek had decided to postpone installation to the Friday.  However, the installation supervisor had forgotten to message me to tell me that.Because I could not be present on the Friday and I needed to know where Soltek planned to place the panels on the western roof and the battery, the installation supervisor reluctantly agreed to visit the site on the Thursday afternoon.  The supervisor wanted me, instead of him, to make the final decision on where to place the panels on the western roof.  I said that I would leave it to him to work it out with the salesman, as I would rely on Soltek's technical expertise.  The positioning of the battery was decided largely because the only alternative position would have incurred additional cost, which I had not been told to expect.The installation appeared to have been carried out well.  Everything was very neat.Once the installation was complete, I received an email inviting me to register for Solar Edge's online monitoring app.  To my surprise, it referred to a 10.14kW system, not a 13.33kW system.  (The generation system is 13.33kW and the battery is 10.14kW.)  I registered and could immediately see how the system was performing.The next day I received another email inviting me to register for Solar Edge's online monitoring app, this time referring to a 13.33kW system. I emailed Soltek about this and was told that the person who sent the second invitation wasn't aware that someone else at Soltek had already sent me an invitation.  Subsequently, I asked both Soltek and Solar Edge which invitation I should accept, but so far neither of them have responded.A week after the system was installed, when I was away for a few days, the monitoring app showed that the system had stopped generating.  When I got back home I took photographs of the inverter (which has 3 indicator lights, but nothing to say what they mean) and my electrical switch box and emailed them to Soltek, asking for advice on whether the system was working and, if not, how to make it work.  Soltek directed me to the part of the monitoring app that re-establishes the connection between the system and the internet.  When I couldn't reconnect the system, Soltek referred me to Solar Edge's support.My conversations with Solar Edge's support ended with it saying that I needed to get my internet service provider to reconfigure my modem (router).  I spent a lot of time communicating with my ISP, but couldn't achieve what Solar Edge said that it needed.Several more communications with Solar Edge and Soltek ended with each of them referring me back to the other to solve the problem.Eventually I carried out an online search and found another installer's advice on how to restart a Solar Edge system.  Following those instructions, I opened my electrical switch box and - with a bit more research - worked out that the generation system had tripped the main switch, so the Solar Edge system was not working at all.  Once I switched it back on, I was able to reconnect the monitoring system and see (a) that the generating system had not worked for about a week and (b) it was now working.The net result of all of this was that I was left with the impression that, once the system had been installed and I had paid for it, Soltek didn't want to be involved any more.  Apart from directing me to Solar Edge support, it simply didn't answer my questions.  Worst of all, it was obvious that Soltek's engineer had not bothered to look at the photos I emailed to Soltek when I got back home, from which she could have seen immediately that the system was switched off.  (It's extraordinary that Soltek didn't raise that as a thing to check as soon as I contacted it.)Solar Edge's support also missed the obvious check to find out whether the system was on or off.  Its advice to have my ISP reconfigure my modem (router) was obviously wrong.The bottom line: I am happy with the Solar Edge system, which is working well.  However, I've learned that it's largely up to me to understand how to manage the system and solve problems, with unreliable support from Solar Ege and no support from Soltek.

It was great to have a face to face appointment with the sales person who we could ask questions to. The quoting process was extremely easy to view.The installers arrived ahead of schedule and were very tidy and careful. A few tiles were broken but these things happen.They were great at answering any of my questions and showed me through the solar app on their phone so I knew what to expect once I downloaded it.Soltek were very efficient and responsive overall.

Sales quoting process was simple and i was give n 2 other options to decide from which didnt corner me into one system.The consultation from the start was very informative and factual and all options laid on the table.I asked MANY questions and they had a quick and informative answer for all my questions which helped me a lot in my final decision to go with Soltek.Installation went very smoothly , taking a bit longer due to weather and shortness of staff ( which is a common issue these days) .Installers were punctual tidy and lovely people to deal with.Customer service has always been good with Soltek , but it took a bit too long to get me connected to the grid. It took a few weeks for this to happen and when the process started it took my provider more than 3 weeks to book a date to install the new .Powerboard so I can start selling to the grid. It actually still has not been installed and is due to be installed tomorrow ( over 1 month after my system had been installed on my roof). This is my only negative comment and was not 100% the fault of Soltek. Red Energy is my provider and they took too long in my opinion to arrange connection after they were advised from Soltek.

the people from Soltek from office staff ,salesman and installers went out of their way to have the system  chosen up and running in the shortest possible time, so a big thank you, the system is performing as we were informed it should ,thanks again

I chose Soltek Energy for my install.  They told me that I had to install a 4 core and earth 16 mm cable from the garage, where the panels are installed, to the main switchboard 56 meters in total.  That is a heavy-duty cable in a domestic situation for sure.The reason to install this cable was, when you install 22 solar panels, as he insisted could be installed, you need two cable strings running to the main switchboard.  Only 21 panels were installed as the installers said the 22nd wasn’t allowed by the installation rules.  They didn’t mention that if the Enphase board were installed in the garage, close to the panels, only one string would be needed back to the main switchboard. That was exactly where the Soltek electrician installed it, in the garage.  If one does a calculation - 21 panels at 410-watt equals 8.61kW at 240V/36amp.  These panels facing north at 2 degrees angle will never produce 8.61kW, maybe 6.61kW on a good day with Enphase micro inverters, so more likely 29amp.  One string over 56 meters would be more than enough, even with the de rating over this distance.Therefore, I could have installed a 2 core and earth 16 square cable and saved $350.00.  By installing the Enphase board in the garage the electrician now had two spare 16 square ml cords to deal with (White and Blue), he installed these on the main earth bar.  Since when is it permissible to install any other colour of cable to the Earth bar other than Yellow/Green?One ADC310T circuit breaker, was removed and not returned to owner.The switchboard was left unlocked at the top, as the left locking point has been damaged.  The switchboard needs replacing, as it no longer can be secured and locked.I had three panels installed on the back roof of the garage facing south. The back bracket is installed at such an angle as it’s pulling the right hand corner down and is putting a lot of strain on the panel.How difficult is it to locate and drill into the middle of a wood support beam when clearly visible from underneath.  These installers obviously do not use measuring tapes or levels?Two panels on the back roof I requested to be installed closer to the gutter didn’t take place, as installed one cable is shading part of this panel.The Soltek sales person, agreed to come and meet me on Monday 29th May.  He did turn up on agreed date, however was very unpleasant and dismissive about all the issues I raised. They agreed to send the electrician out to correct and remove the cores installed on the earth bars (white and blue).As today, 14 June, I haven’t heard from them.  I think it’s a very bad performance of Soltek.We ordered a top of the range solar system worth over $28.000 fully paid for and received a very mediocre installation of it.  When enquiring about the install all we got was dismissiveness and a wall of silence.Finally Mr Peacock I would like to tell you how much admire you for creating the Solar Quotes web site. It’s very informative and right to the point when you are looking to install a solar system. I do meet a lot of people in my travels and am very passionate about solar and I always tell people to log onto Solar Quotes to read up about solar systems and different gear before making a decision of what to install, and finally get three quotes form Finn Peacock at Solar Quotes.Regards:Ingemar.

review_description: I received two quotes through Solarquotes and the experiences were very different.Banana Solar's sales person came out and could tell I was from a technical background, so was able to walk me through the technical parts of the system. Having the monitoring helped as well because I noted that voltage spikes were occurring and leading to my inverter tripping. This alone significantly reduces the effectiveness of the system.I felt I had to chase Soltek and provide them with information rather than have them approach me to resolve the issue.
